mapper.select: SELECT c.city_code, c.city_name, c.province_name, c.lon, c.lat, prev.avg_price AS start_price, curr.avg_price AS end_price, CASE WHEN prev.avg_price > 0 THEN ROUND((curr.avg_price - prev.avg_price) / prev.avg_price * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS change_pct FROM t_yearly_price curr JOIN t_city c ON c.city_code = curr.city_code LEFT JOIN t_yearly_price prev ON prev.city_code = curr.city_code AND prev.year = curr.year - 1 WHERE curr.year = #{year} AND curr.avg_price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY change_pct DESC NULLS LAST
